definitions.explanation: Arranged in a proper, systematic manner; tidy and methodical.

examples.japanese: {整然|せいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: They are lined up in an orderly manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{整然|せいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}いていた→片付く：02041_katazuku⟧。
{整然|せいぜん}とした⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

notes:
{整然|せいぜん} describes something well-organized and orderly, used as a taru-adjective.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
- {整然|せいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb: orderly (adverb)
- {整然|せいぜん}とした + noun: orderly (prenominal)
- {整然|せいぜん}たる + noun: orderly (literary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整然|せいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in an orderly way
- {整然|せいぜん}とした⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧: orderly queue/procession
- {整然|せいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up neatly

USAGE:
- Formal or written style
- Implies systematic organization
- Positive connotation
